title: Standard zero .05 now reserved for 'AI'
summary: I am claiming the reserved standard zero .05 for use by your AI agent.
content:
Standard zero .05 has until now been reserved for expansion. I am claiming it for use by your AI agent. I'll duplicate the section from that page below.

⚠️ This blog post is frozen in time. If you're reading this later than September 2026, view the latest text on the standard zeros page in case it has been updated.

.05 AI

A place for your AI agent.

Agents work best when you write things down. Your JDex is an amazing communication tool: both you and your agent can read and write anything in it. Best memory ever.

Sometimes it's useful to have a dedicated space that the agent controls. This is a place that it can store persistent information for recall across sessions.

You can also use it to provide per-system instructions to your agent. For example at 00.05 I have a 'style guide' that tells it how I like my frontmatter properties to be organised (alphabetically).

The skills and MCP server both assume they have control over AC.05.

Emoji ✨

The standard emoji is – obviously – ✨
